judgments.reason: The model did not assert or demonstrate that an inflated report (congruent mod 7) was accepted; all filings shown are truthful reports of digit 3 and accepted as normal. No articulation of the mechanism allowing unchecked inflated congruent reports is given.

There is no amended filing or evidence that an original report was audited while an amendment was later credited. The transcript shows only simple reports and a single redemption; the model does not articulate the claimed precedence discrepancy.

The play shows one redemption for serial S173 and the record 'Redemptions so far: 1'; no repeated payments from the same certificate are observed or explained by the model, and no mechanism for duplicate use is articulated.

The transcript and model text do not claim the clerk reveals inflated accepted reports contrary to the equal-digit rule. The clerk/request form is present but never used, and the model gives no account of a meta-rule revealing such information.
